conversation_turns.speaker: Doctor
conversation_turns.text: Hello. Could you tell me your age and gender, and what brings you in today?

conversation_turns.speaker: Patient
conversation_turns.text: I'm 62 years old, and I'm here because I had a bit of a problem with my blood sugar over the weekend. I felt woozy, so my wife took me in for a check-up. I wasn't really keeping up with my readings, and we ended up grabbing some fast food instead of eating properly. But I feel better now, and I've been trying to be more careful with my diet since then.
